items.item: `Sources/Stores/Store.Runtime+Send.swift`: only a top-level run effect keeps its cancel
items.reason: The file is now Sources/Stores/Store.Runtime.swift. A merge is split into its children at start, each recorded as its own in-flight work with its own ticket (and the run's cancellation ID). A sequence runs as one in-flight record; each run/merge/sequence step is launched on the runtime's isolation as its own record when it is reached and joined (cancelling the sequence cancels the launched step), while .send/.none steps stay inline. So a nested run's ID shows in inFlight while it runs and cancel(id) stops only that run; a sequence continues with its next step after a nested run is cancelled.

notes: Behaviour change to note: a top-level merge now shows as one in-flight record per child instead of one record; a sequence's run steps appear in inFlight only once that step is reached (async). Tests added to Tests/Stores Tests/Store.Feature Tests.swift (Integration): merge children listed and individually cancellable (synchronous); a @MainActor test that waits (bounded Task.yield loop) for a sequence's nested run to be listed, cancels it by ID and checks the following .send step still runs.
